description: Liste des maîtres d'ouvrage / alimentation en eau potable is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Conseil Départemental de la Gironde. List of Drinking Water Project Managers located in the territory of Gironde. Coverage: Conseil Départemental de la Gironde. The portal shows the English title as "List of contractors/drinking water supply" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Conseil Départemental de la Gironde. Its keywords include eau. The listing shows 2 download or service links in HTML, CSV. The listing shows 2015-04-09 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/summary/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
